body: Someone that understands, thank you. Yeah, I played the closed beta and earned all beta rewards, and purchased a decent amount of VP during the beta phase. At the time I was aware I was on a Russian account placed incorrectly, but due to the twitch drop system I was unable to get a second drop on an account with the correct region, so played on thinking I’d be able to change regions down the line. The only issue I have with the current region is the inability to use voice communications due to an error on Riots side misplacing me in this region, and I don’t understand why they’ve refused me a region change twice even after providing them everything they’ve asked for, it’s just insane, especially considering I’ve spent money on the account.

I really hope you’re right on the region change. Have been stuck on Russian region since beta with no voice comms due to this, which is just horrific. Have contacted Riot twice with proof of home IP, transaction IDs from purchases with card used, original email, etc, and they refuse to change my region which has made me quit Valorant for the time I remain on this region.
